title: SemQueryBench Evaluation Result Row
description: Long-format row schema for organizing SemQueryBench baseline prediction and evaluation results.

question.description: Natural-language question. Optional for public test result files if the benchmark dataset already provides it.

Gold-sql.description: Gold SQL. Required for dev evaluation input; must be omitted from public test result files.

model.description: LLM name, e.g., qwen-72b, qwen-max, DeepSeek-r1, GPT-5.4, CLAUDE-OPUs-4.8.

pred-sql.description: Predicted SQL generated by the baseline method.

Execute Acc.description: Execution match / EM label. Use 1 for correct and 0 for incorrect.

Efficient Acc.description: EffM label. Use 1 for efficient/correct alternative and 0 for incorrect.

diff desc.description: Natural-language description of the main difference between gold SQL and predicted SQL.
